routeFailedHelp: Try loading the page again. If it still fails, refresh this tab.
unconfirmed: The server has not confirmed your change yet.
unsaved: You have an unsaved draft on this page.
mayHaveSaved: The server may have saved this change, or may not have received it.
stayToRetry: Stay on this page and wait for confirmation or retry the same change.
draftLeaveHelp: Leaving or switching users will discard your unsaved draft. Stay to save it or discard it explicitly.
chooseWorkspaceHelp: Choose a workspace to open its pages.
serverActorNotice: Showing data for the user currently selected by the server.
leaveRetryHelp: Leaving will clear the values needed to retry this change safely. Before creating it again, check what the server already saved.
switchRetryHelp: Switching users will clear the values needed to retry this change safely. Before creating it again, check what the server already saved.
routeFilesFailedHelp: The page files could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again. If Workloom was updated, refresh this tab.
appUpdatedHelp: This tab is using an older version. Refresh it to open the page with the current version. Your current page address will be kept.
appRootMissing: The application could not find its root element.
